'''Cream of mushroom soup''' is a simple type of [[soup]] where a basic [[roux]] is thinned with [[cream]] or [[milk]] and then [[Edible mushroom|mushrooms]] or mushroom [[broth]] are added.

In North America, it is a common [[Tin can|canned]] [[Soup#Canned|condensed]] soup. Cream of mushroom soup is often used as a base ingredient in [[casserole]]s and [[comfort food]]s. This use is similar to that of a mushroom-flavored [[gravy]].
